## About
:::

::: {.section-copy}
My name is Quique (short for Enrique) Clari. I am a PhD candidate in the Department of Political Science and International Relations at the Autonomous University of Madrid. In my PhD project, directed by Guillermo Cordero (UAM) and Enrique Hernández (UAB), I investigate whether public support for liberal values and principles has declined in the last decade.

My research has been supported by a “la Caixa” INPhINIT fellowship (2022–2025) and a Fulbright predoctoral fellowship at Yale University (2025–2026), hosted by Milan W. Svolik. I hold a master’s degree in Political Theory from the London School of Economics and a double BA in Law and Political Science from the University of Valencia.
:::
